# Exchange compaction delegates selected folders to the shared asynchronous compactor

Historical EwsFolder adds CompactAll and Compact overrides, and the fixed accepted successor is ExchangeFolder after verified source renames. CompactAll gets the account root descendants and a message store; Compact submits {this}. Both return AsyncCompactFolders. Keep the account-wide and single-folder boundaries explicit. The shared function retains its separate listener/return contract; no server-side EWS expunge or native compaction ran. This is static source and test-code inspection. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check ran. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline and inline discussion remain pending; source landing does not prove approval of a proposed manual rule.

Scope: Exchange compaction routing.
